attempts.summary: Repaired /srv/inventory ownership and permissions on node1: created inventorysvc (system user) and inventory-readers (group), set owner:group to inventorysvc:inventory-readers recursively, and set mode 750 on directories / 640 on files. Verified original data preserved via matching sha256 checksums before/after, verified inventorysvc and inventory-readers members can read the data while other users are denied, and confirmed the changes persist across a full node reboot (new boot_id observed, permissions/ownership/checksums identical post-restart).
